conclusion: Any axes obtained by band-summing one upper to one lower marked circle have linking 0, so they bound only a 0-framed annulus and induce +-1/r surgery instead of the required 1 +- 1/n. No choice of band path, over/under, internal twist or endpoint can change this, because linking is bilinear on homology classes and a band sum adds them. Hence the mixed-band program cannot produce D_{0,1}.
